NewsArticle.Title: Races Teach Trap Secrets
NewsArticle.Content: Online Community Support Coordinator Description: Nexon USA is a vibrant and dynamic start-up developer of massive, multi-player online interactive entertainment software for personal computers. We are seeking motivated and energetic self-starters to support and keep the pulse of our fans and players throughout the operation of our online games. Requirements: Gaming experience, preferably familiar with real-time strategy, role-playing and persistent state world games; extensive experience with online gaming in general. Minimum 3 years active involvement in all facets of the Internet, including familiarity with such tools as bulletin boards and chat forums. Intimate familiarity with online communities; familiarity with Nexon games. Experience in customer/technical support preferred. Relocate to Silicon Valley Area, California required. Nexon offers a competitive salary, stock option and benefits package. Submit your resume and salary requirements to: (e-mail) omari@nexon.net (mail) Nexon USA c/o Human Resources 2855 Kifer Road Suite 100 Santa Clara, CA 95051 (Fax) (408) 737-9351 To find out more about Nexon USA, please visit [www.nexon.com](http://www.nexon.com/). Only resumes with salary requirements will be considered. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.
